description: t.watch monitors t.target and waits for the DOWN at priority 0, and the driver cancels it at 150 ns: its await_down is Cancelled and it goes on to a sleep, its cleanup budget now running it at priority 210, while the monitor still holds the waker the await registered. t.target (a deadline-0 budget, so priority 128) wakes at 150, spawns a child and finishes: the DOWN wakes t.watch through that stored waker, at priority 0, and the child, admitted at the next step at priority 128, runs before it. A wake at the task's latest priority (210) would run t.watch first.
